question: Can a new supervised reproducibility score be prospectively promoted on labelled target feedback without treating correlated time-series observations as independent evidence?
source: statsmodels 0.14.6 fertility, World Bank WDI fertility rate 1960-2013; pycountry ISO3-filtered countries only
unit: one country-year prediction; label requires observed next-year fertility
label: 1 if fertility(t+1) - fertility(t) <= -0.05 births/woman, 0 otherwise
missing: remove country-years missing any required historical feature, current/next-year target or country code; no interpolation
country_filter: pycountry ISO-3166-1 alpha3 country code membership; report excluded codes

error_models.both: LogisticRegression(C=1,max_iter=2000) with StandardScaler fit only on risk_fit

threshold: validation-score quantile with fixed deterministic tie hash at hash seed 71250; no held-out labels used
primary_unit_of_sequential_monitoring: year mean of per-case frozen paired gains; chronological 1999-2004 years
secondary_unit: country-year rows; deliberately INVALID e-process interpretation under within-year shared shocks

evalue.positive_null: E[year_mean_gain_t | history_through_year_t-1] <= 0 for every monitored year
evalue.negative_alarm: analogous evidence for harm; descriptive, not independent confirmation

operational_gate: activate conditional model on future block only if positive yearwise evidence >=20 during monitoring; otherwise keep supervised confidence-only rule
future_interpretation: future block is labelled for descriptive counterfactual evaluation only; no guarantee of future safe benefit from prior labels

synthetic_negative_control.null_world: within each year all country rows share one fair +/-0.5 gain shock, year shocks independent
synthetic_negative_control.comparison: false activation treating rows as IID versus aggregation to independent years

secondary_check: positive-benefit world with genuinely independent year shocks; does not represent real time-series prevalence
forbidden: using future outcomes to tune models or thresholds
asserting countries independent in the same calendar year
claiming target-future guarantee under arbitrary drift
turning a retrospective analysis into a preregistered confirmatory finding
